session_summary: A patient visited a doctor for persistent cough, fever, and fatigue. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended tests, and issued a sick leave. The patient was advised to quit smoking and attend a cessation program.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Chest X-ray
proposed_actions.description: Get a chest X-ray done at the county hospital radiology department.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want a chest X-ray today or at the latest tomorrow.

proposed_actions.title: Take Medication
proposed_actions.description: Take amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, one thousand milligrams, twice a day, for seven days.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, one thousand milligrams, twice a day, for seven days.

proposed_actions.title: Take Paracetamol for Fever
proposed_actions.description: Take paracetamol for fever, no more than four tablets a day.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: For the fever take paracetamol, no more than four tablets a day.

proposed_actions.title: Get Sick Leave Certificate
proposed_actions.description: Collect the sick leave certificate from the doctor and take it to human resources.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll issue the medical leave certificate now, you take it to human resources.

proposed_actions.title: Undergo Blood Tests
proposed_actions.description: Undergo a hematology panel and C-reactive protein test tomorrow morning on an empty stomach.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: You'll also do a hematology panel and C-reactive protein test, tomorrow morning, on an empty stomach.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Follow-up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Attend a follow-up appointment on Tuesday, November 10th, at half past eight, with the X-ray and test results.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll be waiting for you on Tuesday, November 10th, at half past eight, with the X-ray and test results.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Smoking Cessation Program
proposed_actions.description: Attend the smoking cessation program at the clinic.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I recommend the smoking cessation program at the clinic.

decisions: The patient will not work for five days, up to Tuesday inclusive.
risks: If the fever goes above thirty-nine or the patient has trouble breathing, they should come immediately or call the emergency department.
follow_up_questions: When will the smoking cessation program start?
